mentions.name: MailTrigger
mentions.description: A programmable SMTP server that turns any email into a message on LINE, Slack, Teams, Telegram, SMS, or other channels — an 'SMTP to Anything' email-native IFTTT/Zapier. It supports JS and WASM for preprocessing, routing, and automation, including custom logic, auto-replies with LLM-generated messages, and intelligent alert forwarding, and is experimenting with defining notification logic in natural language. Used for price drop alerts, server health monitoring, and pushing Jenkins/Sentry incidents to a DevOps Telegram channel.
mentions.problem: If an app can only send email, triggering multi-channel notifications normally requires extra code.
